holes_in_opposing_case: Dollar-king's own original admits the US-Canada gap is historically extreme in rates while USDCAD is only 74th 1y / 87th 5y. That is an argument against expressing the view in USDCAD. Long the milder FX stretch is fading CAD on the instrument that has not dislocated, not owning the 4th-percentile 5y CA-US 2Y / 156bp overnight policy gap.

Carry-is-king and rate-dove mis-normalize: they treat +84bp of CORRA catch-up from 2.29 as the rich object, while the valuation object is the LEVEL, 2.29 versus SOFR 3.85. Their own scans record CA-US 2Y at the 3.8th/4.3rd percentile and Mar-27 STIR gap 143.5bp, then they refuse the RV so they can harvest a path premium that requires the 5y tail to stay broken.

Rate-dove states explicitly that a Canada-stays-easier view wants CA-US 2Y more negative. That is a bet the 4th-percentile 5y cheapness gets cheaper. It is not a valuation close; it is an anti-convergence expression dressed as labor/core patience.

Rate-hawk scans CA-US 2Y, calls paying US versus Canada 'already an extreme,' then pays US duration anyway via SOFR_2027-09 into a 99.8th-percentile 1y US 2Y. That concedes the peer dislocation and trades the expensive leg.

Trend-follower's AUD higher collides with AUDCAD at the 99.96th 5y percentile, AU 2Y at the 99th percentile, and NSW stamp-duty receipts -24% y/y. NZD lower fades NZDUSD at the 8.6th 5y percentile with NZ official yields unavailable. Those are trend claims on 5y FX tails, not a reason the US-CA policy gap is fair.

Carry's 2025-01-30 analog (CA-US 2Y -145bp, then +25bp over 3m) is in their own original and they still receive CORRA / want CAD lower. They cite the compression analog and trade as if it does not exist.
attack: Strongest opposing claim: Canada labor 38, employment -42k, trim/median 1.9/2.0 mean the 84-111bp of priced CORRA hikes will not be delivered, so CAD stays the cheap-funding residual, USD stays bid, and long USDCAD or receiving CORRA is the clean trade.

FACT: that labor/core state is already in overnight CORRA 2.29. INFERENCE: using it a second time to justify a 140bp 2027H1 gap versus a delivered Fed hike and US gauges 72/75/69 double-counts slack. CA activity 66 and Q2 GDP +0.8% q/q sit next to US activity 69. The priced assumption is that slack freezes the LEVEL through 2027H1; the strip already prices ~100bp by 2028-06, so even the market's own back end disagrees.

Dollar-king converts a rates extreme into a USD call because the seat is spot-only. The same facts say USDCAD has not gone to the tail. Long 1.401 after +1.10% in five days is chasing the non-extreme leg of a peer-policy dislocation. If Canada catch-up or US 2Y mean-reversion closes the 140bp gap, USDCAD is the lagging, oil-beta-contaminated expression, not the owner.

Carry and the dove need BoC to refuse the very energy pass-through the 2 Sep minutes flagged. Their invalidation — trim/median leave 1.9/2.0 and jobs stop contracting — is this seat's catalyst. Saudi/Oman workaround versus weakening shock-absorbers is two-way UNKNOWN; it is not permission to treat 2.29 as the 2027H1 equilibrium versus SOFR 3.85.

Hawks and trend are aligned with a hiking cycle that is already in US 2Y 4.76 (+57bp 1m, 99.8th 1y) and SR3 2027-03/09 at 4.565/4.735. Continuity of a delivered hike does not make a 4th-percentile 5y CA-US 2Y fair. Paying more US rate into that percentile is the expensive-peer trade, not a valuation.

USD lower / CAD higher in the Round-1 synopsis are implications if Canada catch-up is the closing channel; the book already rejected short USDCAD as inferior (74th/87th versus a 4th-percentile 5y rates gap).
